app.name: 1% Better per Day
app.tagline: 1% better, one day at a time.

toast.signedOutKept: Signed out. Your data is still on this device.
toast.signedOutRemoved: Signed out. Data removed from this device.
toast.mergeDone: Signed in. Your account now has {{goals}}, {{entries}}.

errors.GOAL_NAME_REQUIRED: Enter a name for your goal.
errors.GOAL_NAME_TOO_LONG: Name must be 60 characters or fewer.
errors.GOAL_WHY_TOO_LONG: Why must be 280 characters or fewer.
errors.GOAL_TARGET_INVALID_daily: Enter a whole number of minutes from 1 to 1,440.
errors.GOAL_TARGET_INVALID_total: Enter a whole number of hours from 1 to 10,000.
errors.GOAL_TARGET_INVALID_tooMuch: That's more than 1,440 minutes a day for this period. Lower the hours or choose a later end date.
errors.GOAL_PERIOD_INVALID_endBeforeStart: End date must be on or after the start date.
errors.GOAL_PERIOD_INVALID_tooLong: A goal can last up to 1,827 days (about 5 years). Choose an earlier end date.
errors.GOAL_PERIOD_INVALID_openEndedTotal: A Total hours goal needs an end date. Choose when it ends, or switch to Minutes per day.
errors.GOAL_PERIOD_EXCLUDES_ENTRIES: Some of your entries fall outside these dates. Choose dates that include every logged day, or delete those entries first.
errors.GOAL_NOT_FOUND: This goal doesn't exist anymore. It may have been deleted.
errors.ENTRY_NOT_FOUND: This entry doesn't exist anymore. It may have been deleted.
errors.ENTRY_MINUTES_INVALID: Enter a whole number of minutes from 1 to 1,440.
errors.ENTRY_NOTE_TOO_LONG: Note must be 280 characters or fewer.
errors.ENTRY_DAY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: A goal can have at most 1,440 minutes in one day. You can add up to {{remaining}} more for this day.
errors.ENTRY_DAY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED_full: This day is already full (1,440 minutes).
errors.DATE_IN_FUTURE: You can't log time for a future date.
errors.DATE_OUTSIDE_GOAL_PERIOD: That date is outside this goal's dates ({{start}} – {{end}}).
errors.DATE_OUTSIDE_GOAL_PERIOD_openEnded: That date is before this goal starts ({{start}}).
errors.WRITE_FAILED: Couldn't save. Your changes are still in the form — try again.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.GOAL_NOT_ACTIVE: Timers can only run on active goals.
errors.TIMER_ALREADY_RUNNING: A timer is already running. Stop it before starting another.
errors.NOTIFICATIONS_UNSUPPORTED: This browser doesn't support notifications. You'll still see a reminder banner in the app.
errors.NOTIFICATIONS_DENIED: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser's site settings, then come back. You'll still see a reminder banner in the app.
errors.IMPORT_FILE_TOO_LARGE: This file is larger than 5 MB, so it can't be a 1% Better backup. Choose a different file. Nothing was changed.
errors.IMPORT_INVALID_JSON: This file isn't valid JSON. Choose a backup exported from 1% Better. Nothing was changed.
errors.IMPORT_INVALID_SCHEMA: This file doesn't look like a 1% Better backup. Choose a file exported from this app. Nothing was changed.
errors.IMPORT_INVALID_SCHEMA_outOfRange: This backup contains a value 1% Better doesn't allow, such as a goal period longer than 1,827 days, minutes outside 1–1,440, or a name or note that's too long. Fix the file, or export a fresh backup from this app. Nothing was changed.
errors.EXPORT_FAILED: Couldn't create the backup file. Your data on this device is unchanged. Try again, and if it keeps failing, check that your browser allows downloads from this site.
errors.IMPORT_UNSUPPORTED_VERSION: This backup uses a format version ({{v}}) this app can't read. Export it again from an up-to-date copy of the app. Nothing was changed.
errors.IMPORT_INTEGRITY: This backup is inconsistent (for example, entries that don't belong to any goal). Nothing was changed.
errors.loadViewBody: Check your connection if you just updated the app, then try again.
errors.GOAL_TIMER_RUNNING: Stop or discard the running timer before archiving this goal.
errors.AUTH_OFFLINE: You're offline. Connect to the internet, then sign in.
errors.AUTH_CANCELLED: Sign-in was cancelled. You're not signed in, and nothing on this device changed.
errors.AUTH_FAILED: Couldn't sign you in. Nothing on this device changed. Try again, and finish signing in in the same browser where you started.
errors.AUTH_SESSION_EXPIRED: Your sign-in expired. Sign in again to keep syncing. Your data, including changes that haven't synced yet, is kept on this device.
errors.SYNC_OFFLINE: You're offline. Your changes are saved on this device and will sync when you're back online.
errors.SYNC_UNREACHABLE: Couldn't reach your account just now. Your changes are safe on this device. We'll try again soon, or you can tap Sync now.
errors.SYNC_UNAUTHORIZED: Your sign-in is no longer valid. Sign in again to keep syncing. Your data on this device is safe.
errors.SYNC_REMOTE_INVALID: Some items from your account couldn't be read and were skipped. Everything else is synced.
errors.EXPORT_FAILED_native: Couldn't create the backup file. Your data on this device is unchanged. Try again, and if it keeps failing, free up some space on your iPhone.

today.noGoalsBody: Pick something you want to do a little every day. Log your time and watch it add up.
today.noActiveBody: Your goals haven't started yet, have ended, or are archived.

empty.goalsBody: Pick something you want to do a little every day. Log your time and watch it add up.

detail.historyBody: Time you log for this goal will show up here.
detail.curve: Your line starts on the first day you log time. That day is your starting point (0%).

day.noGoals: No goals were running on this day
day.noGoalsBody: Goals show up here on the days they're active.
day.noEntries: No time logged for this goal on this day.

empty.reviewBody: Create a goal and log some time. Your year will show up here.

today.title: Today
today.allOnTarget_one: Goal on target — a little better than yesterday.
today.allOnTarget_other: All {{count}} goals on target — a little better than yesterday.
today.pastDayLink: Missed a day? Log time for a past day

delete.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
delete.bodyNoEntries: This permanently deletes the goal. It has no entries yet. This can't be undone.
delete.body_one: This permanently deletes the goal and its 1 entry. This can't be undone.
delete.body_other: This permanently deletes the goal and its {{count}} entries. This can't be undone.
delete.timerNote: Its running timer will be discarded.

form.whyPlaceholder: Why does this matter to you?
form.hintTotal: That's about {{daily}} min per day over {{days}}.
form.startHint: Your entries run from {{first}} to {{last}}, so the period must include those dates.
form.endsNeverHint: The goal keeps running every day until you archive or delete it. Progress is measured up to today.
form.endsNeverTotalNote: Only available for Minutes per day. Total hours needs an end date to work out your daily target.
form.endsNeverSwitched: Ends changed to This year, because No end date only works with Minutes per day.

detail.headline: {{value}}% better
detail.subStart: Starting point: {{minutes}} on {{date}}. Your line moves once you log on another day.
detail.chartCaption: Line chart comparing the ideal +1% a day curve with how your logged time changes from day to day
detail.chartSummary: Day {{k}} of {{total}}: your line is {{x}}% compared with your first logged day. The ideal line is {{y}}%.
detail.chartSummaryEmpty: Day {{k}} of {{total}}: nothing logged yet. The ideal line is {{y}}%.
detail.chartSummaryOpen: Day {{k}}: your line is {{x}}% compared with your first logged day. The ideal line is {{y}}%.
detail.chartSummaryEmptyOpen: Day {{k}}: nothing logged yet. The ideal line is {{y}}%.
detail.chartNote: Each day you log is compared with your previous logged day, and the changes multiply from your first day. Days without time keep the line flat. Logging less than before moves it down.
detail.tooltipChange: {{date}} · {{minutes}}, {{change}}% vs previous logged day · You {{you}}% since your first day · Ideal {{ideal}}%
detail.tooltipBase: {{date}} · {{minutes}}, your first logged day · You {{you}}% · Ideal {{ideal}}%
detail.tooltipFlat: {{date}} · Nothing logged, the line stays flat · You {{you}}% · Ideal {{ideal}}%
detail.upcoming: Starts {{date}}. Your line will appear once the goal begins.

language.title: Language / Ngôn ngữ
language.desc: Choose the language of menus, messages and dates. Your own goal names and notes stay as you wrote them.
language.browserNote: The date and time pickers and permission prompts follow your browser's language.
language.saveFailed: Language changed, but it couldn't be saved on this device. It may reset when you reload.
language.syncNote: Saved to your account and used on your other devices.
language.nativeNote: The date and time pickers and permission prompts follow your iPhone's language.

account.title: Account
account.descSignedOut: Sign in with Google to keep a copy of your goals and entries in your account and use them on all your devices. You don't need an account to use 1% Better.
account.privacyNote: From Google, the app only receives your name and email.
account.offlineHint: You're offline. Connect to the internet to sign in.
account.signingInBody: Finishing up. This only takes a moment.
account.syncedInfo: Synced with this account: goals, entries, reminder settings and language. A running timer stays on the device where you started it.
account.offlineSync: You're offline. Changes are saved on this device and sync when you're back online.
account.localRejected_one: 1 item on this device couldn't be uploaded to your account and stays only here. Export a backup to keep a copy; everything else is synced.
account.localRejected_other: {{count}} items on this device couldn't be uploaded to your account and stay only here. Export a backup to keep a copy; everything else is synced.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.switchDesc: Get a nudge when you haven't hit your targets today.
reminders.limit: Heads up: reminders are sent only while 1% Better is open (in a tab or an installed window, even in the background). To be reminded when the app is closed, add a daily event to your calendar.
reminders.ios: On iPhone or iPad, notifications work only after you add this app to your Home Screen (iOS 16.4 or later).
reminders.icsHint: Adds a repeating daily event at {{time}}.
reminders.syncNote: Reminder on/off and time are saved to your account and used on your other devices. Notification permission is set separately on each device.

permission.defaultDesc: Turn on the reminder and your browser will ask for permission.
permission.grantedDesc: You'll get one notification a day while 1% Better is open.
permission.defaultOnDesc: Reminders are on, but this device hasn't allowed notifications yet. Allow them to get a notification; you'll still see the reminder banner in the app.
permission.nativeUnsupportedDesc: Reminder notifications aren't available in this version of the app. You'll still see a reminder banner in the app.

backup.title: Backup
backup.desc: Your data lives only on this device. Export a backup now and then, or to move to another device.
backup.importHint: Importing replaces everything currently on this device.
backup.descSignedIn: Your data is saved on this device and synced to your account. A backup file is an extra copy you keep yourself.
backup.importHintSignedIn: Importing replaces everything on this device and in your account.
backup.descSignedOut: Your data lives on this device. Sign in to keep a copy in your account too, or export a backup file now and then.
backup.shareHint: Export opens the iOS share sheet. Choose Save to Files, AirDrop, Mail or another app.

storage.title: Storage
storage.label: Protection from automatic clearing
storage.protectedDesc: Your browser won't clear this data automatically.
storage.notProtectedDesc: Your browser may clear this data if the device runs low on space. Install the app (browser menu → Install, or Add to Home Screen) and export a backup now and then.
storage.unknownDesc: Your browser doesn't report storage protection. Export a backup now and then.
storage.notProtectedSignIn: Signing in also keeps a copy of your data in your account.
storage.nativeDesc: Your data is kept inside this app on your iPhone. Deleting the app deletes this data, and iOS may clear it if the iPhone runs very low on space. Export a backup now and then.

about.title: About
about.desc: Everything you log stays on this device. No account, no tracking.
about.descCloud: Everything you log is saved on this device first. Signing in is optional, and there's no tracking.
about.descSignedIn: Everything you log is saved on this device first and synced to your account. There's no tracking.
about.privacy: If you sign in, your goals, entries, reminder settings and language are stored in this app's database (Supabase) under your account. Other people who use the app can't see them.
about.descNative: Everything you log stays on this iPhone. No account, no tracking.

notFound.pageBody: That page doesn't exist or has moved.

storageError.title: Can't open local storage
storageError.body: 1% Better keeps your data in your browser's storage, and it isn't available right now. This often happens in private or incognito windows, or when site data is blocked in browser settings. Nothing has been changed.
storageError.step1: Open the app in a regular (non-private) window.
storageError.step2: Allow site data and cookies for this site in your browser settings.
storageError.bodyNative: 1% Better keeps your data in this app's storage on your iPhone, and it isn't available right now. Nothing has been changed.
storageError.step1Native: Close 1% Better completely and open it again.
storageError.step3Native: Make sure your iPhone has some free space.

timer.roundedHint: Rounded from {{raw}}. You can change it.

reminder.banner_one: It's past {{time}} — 1 goal is not on target yet.
reminder.banner_other: It's past {{time}} — {{count}} goals are not on target yet.

day.title: Day
day.onlyRunning: Only goals running on this day are shown.

banner.never: You haven't backed up yet. Export a backup so your data is safe if this browser clears it.
banner.old: It's been {{n}} days since your last backup.
banner.neverNative: You haven't backed up yet. Export a backup so your data is safe if you delete the app or switch iPhones.

import.title: Replace all data?
import.body: This backup has {{goals}}, {{entries}}, exported {{date}}. Importing replaces everything currently on this device ({{curGoals}}, {{curEntries}}). This can't be undone.
import.titleSignedIn: Replace data on all your devices?
import.bodySignedIn: This backup has {{goals}}, {{entries}}, exported {{date}}. Importing replaces everything currently on this device ({{curGoals}}, {{curEntries}}) and, once synced, everything in your account too, so it changes your other devices as well. This can't be undone.
import.offlineNote: You're offline, so the change will reach your account when you're back online.

heatmap.legendAll: Colors show total minutes per day.
heatmap.legendGoal: Colors show the share of your daily target.
heatmap.summary: In {{year}} you logged time on {{logged}} and hit your target on {{met}}. Longest streak: {{streak}}.

bar.weeklySummary: Last 12 weeks: {{total}} logged, busiest week starting {{date}} with {{max}}.
bar.empty: No time logged in this range.

stat.daysOnTargetSub: Days you hit your daily target

review.title: Review
review.pickGoal: Pick a goal to see progress and pace.
review.progressNote: Progress and pace cover the whole goal period.
review.progressNoteOpen: Progress and pace for a goal with no end date are measured up to today.

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.body: The app ran into an unexpected problem. Your data is still stored on this device.

signOut.title: Sign out?
signOut.body: You'll stop syncing on this device. Your data in your account stays safe.
signOut.legend: What should happen to the data on this device?
signOut.keepDesc: Recommended. You can keep using 1% Better without an account.
signOut.removeDesc: Deletes your goals, entries and reminder settings on this device. Choose this on a shared device. Your account keeps everything.
signOut.unsynced_one: 1 change hasn't synced to your account yet.
signOut.unsynced_other: {{count}} changes haven't synced to your account yet.
signOut.unsyncedOnline: We'll try to sync before signing you out.
signOut.unsyncedOffline: You're offline, so they can't sync right now. If you keep the data on this device, they'll sync when you sign in again with this account.
signOut.unsyncedRemove: If you remove the data from this device, these changes will be lost.
signOut.syncFailed: Couldn't sync your changes. If you remove the data now, they will be lost.
signOut.rejected_one: 1 item on this device couldn't be uploaded to your account.
signOut.rejected_other: {{count}} items on this device couldn't be uploaded to your account.
signOut.rejectedKeep: Whatever couldn't be uploaded stays on this device if you keep the data here. Export a backup to keep a copy.
signOut.rejectedRemove: If you remove the data from this device, anything that couldn't be uploaded will be lost. Export a backup first to keep it.
signOut.removeDescRejected: Deletes your goals, entries and reminder settings on this device. Choose this on a shared device. Items that couldn't be uploaded are not in your account.

merge.title: Add this device's data to your account?
merge.body: This device still has {{goals}}, {{entries}} from another account. If you continue, they'll be added to the account {{email}}, next to what's already there.
merge.note: Cancel signs you out. Nothing is uploaded.

announce.offline: You're offline. Changes will sync when you're back online.
announce.error: Sync failed. Your changes are safe on this device and will be retried.
announce.expired: Your sign-in expired. Sign in again to keep syncing.

loginPrompt.label: Sign-in suggestion
loginPrompt.title: Keep your progress safe
loginPrompt.body: Sign in to back up your goals and entries online and use them on all your devices. It's optional.
loginPrompt.snoozedToast: OK. You can sign in any time from Settings.

exportHint.label: Automatic backup
exportHint.text: Backup downloaded. To keep a copy automatically, sign in with Google: your goals and entries then sync to your account.
